sites.title: 62chan
sites.description: An imageboard about the Signal on 62. Registrar offshore, moderator gone since August 2024, roughly eighteen bot posts for every human one.

sites.title: Kestrel Road Weather Station - Ashkettle
sites.description: Len Mabry's home weather station on Kestrel Road in Ashkettle: daily readings, monthly tables, a dead webcam and a guestbook, last updated 17 April 2011.

sites.title: Village of Ashkettle
sites.description: Five pages for a village of nine hundred people, kept by one part-time clerk on a template the County supplies, including a zoning ordinance too large to upload and a water tower that is currently empty.

sites.title: Ashkettle Volunteer Fire Department
sites.description: Station 4 in Ashkettle: roster, two engines and a tanker with mileage, a mutual aid page that gets the 2003 Gridfall substation fire right, and a fundraiser thermometer that has read 62 percent since 2012.

sites.title: VerityAssist - Your County, Answered
sites.description: A regional AI assistant trained on public data from Verity County. It answers everything instantly and is wrong about most of it.

sites.title: AskVerity
sites.description: Questions and answers about Verity County. One of several hundred identical local Q&A sites, all moderated by the same bot.

sites.title: bluekestrel.com
sites.description: A registrar holding page on the diner's old domain: this domain may be for sale, a box of automatically generated related searches, three ads and a disclaimer.

sites.title: The Gridfall Boards
sites.description: General-purpose message board for Gridfall and the rest of Verity County.

sites.title: Cold Start - brackenlanegarage.net
sites.description: The website of Cold Start, a four-piece bar band out of Gridfall, built and maintained by the bass player: three upcoming dates, a page of songs nobody can listen to, one shirt, and a news page that stopped last October.

sites.title: Brenner's Verity Notebook
sites.description: Hal Brenner's paid monthly newsletter out of Gridfall: one properly sourced county story a month, written by the man the Ledger laid off in 2019 and then used as a byline in 2023.

sites.title: Carrow Wireless Repair - Route 62, Ashkettle
sites.description: The website of the one-man phone repair shop in the old Blue Kestrel diner building on Route 62: prices by model, a forty-minute turnaround, and a page about the building that is one paragraph long.

sites.title: Verity Classifieds — Local Listings, County Wide
sites.description: The county's classifieds board, forty years old in print and six years old under its current owner. Most of it is posted from somewhere else. Some of it is a neighbour clearing out a garage.

sites.title: ClipVault Shorts
sites.description: Vertical video. Verity County's last hundred years compressed into forty-second clips, most of which are wrong, none of which cite anything.

sites.title: ClipVault
sites.description: Video uploads from around Verity County: camcorder tape, rail footage, hall shows, tool demos and radio recordings.

sites.title: Code & Coffee
sites.description: Dave Carrow writes about servers, county networking, and things he has measured in Verity County.

sites.title: VerityNet Control Panel
sites.description: Your account, your posts, installed content packs, and the sites you have authored. Local to this device.

sites.title: County Alerts — Verity County
sites.description: An automated breaking-alerts account that rewrites Verity County scanner traffic in under a minute, at volume, with nobody reading it first.

sites.title: CountyFacts - Verity County Answered
sites.description: Comprehensive guides to Verity County, generated at volume, monetised with affiliate links, and wrong about the substation fire in every article.

sites.title: Verity County Adult Softball League
sites.description: Thirty-six teams, five divisions, a rainout recording, four pages of courtesy runner rules, and a Hall of Fame plaque that has been behind the ice cream freezer since 2011.

sites.title: County Supply Co. — Farm, Fence & Hardware — Marchfield
sites.description: The last farm store in Verity County, selling real t-posts and real chainsaw chain through an e-commerce platform that writes its own product descriptions and will not let the owner delete the fake reviews.

sites.title: Coyne Flats Community Association
sites.description: The community association for Coyne Flats, a settlement of 400 at the end of the branch line: the hall, the August chicken barbecue, the depot that stood from 1898 to 1987, and a links page last checked in January 2011.

sites.title: Verity Dash - Smart County Overview
sites.description: The Verity County smart-county dashboard. Twelve live widgets, four of which are live.

sites.title: Fenner Insurance Agency, Inc. - Marchfield
sites.description: The website of an independent insurance agency on Bellamy Street in Marchfield: nine template pages about types of insurance, staff photographs described but not shown, a quote form that goes nowhere, and a syndicated safety-tip feed that stopped in July 2014.

sites.title: Verity Rail Enthusiasts' Forum
sites.description: Discussion board for the Verity Rail line, its branches, and the people who photograph them.

sites.title: Gridfall Buy & Sell
sites.description: Ronnie Pelt has typed up other people's ads on this site since 2014, mostly farm equipment, tools and furniture, and adds his own notes in brackets when he thinks you are being had.

sites.title: Verity Help Desk (unofficial)
sites.description: A small chat server where people in Verity County ask each other why the printer is doing that, including a read-only import of the Users Group board that closed in 2014.

sites.title: Gridfall, Verity County
sites.description: The chat server the Gridfall boards moved to in 2021, including the read-only import of the old phpBB.

sites.title: Gridfall Deals — Your Local Verity County Store
sites.description: A storefront that says it is a family business on Ellery Street in Gridfall, selling county-name merchandise that ships from somewhere else in eighteen to thirty-two days, with a returns policy that closes its own window before the parcel lands.

sites.title: Gridfall & District Detectorists
sites.description: The metal detecting club's board: finds posted with depth and soil, a permission letter anybody can copy, and a rule about the old branch right-of-way that gets restated every few weeks.

sites.title: Gridfall Host
sites.description: Web hosting, e-mail and domain names for Verity County, run by two people out of two rooms on Third Street in Gridfall since 2002.

sites.title: Gridfall Pizza — 142 Third Street, Gridfall
sites.description: A takeout pizza shop on Third Street in Gridfall, run by three of the same family, on a storefront template that only knows how to sell products and a third-party order button that does not work on some phones.

sites.title: Gridfall Swap
sites.description: Buy, sell and give away things in Verity County. Started in 2017 when the old boards stopped taking new members, and still the only local forum anybody posts on.

sites.title: Gridfall Tire & Alignment
sites.description: The website of a tire and alignment shop on Depot Street in Gridfall, built on a template in 2011, last changed in August 2014, and still telling people the shop is open on Saturdays.

sites.title: Gridline
sites.description: A link aggregator for Verity County, incorporated somewhere else, moderated by nobody since spring 2025.

sites.title: Halloran Media Group
sites.description: The corporate site of the newspaper chain that owned the Verity Ledger from 2011 to 2016. Never taken down after the sale. Still listing fourteen titles, still hiring one multimedia journalist.

sites.title: The Halsey Ledger
sites.description: A Pinelock property named after a town of 2,100 that has never had a newspaper, running the same pipeline and the same template as the rest of the group.

sites.title: Hollis Market — 160 Mill Street, Gridfall
sites.description: The family grocery on Mill Street in Gridfall, with this week's ad, the deli menu, the meat counter and an order form that sends an email to the store and nothing else.

sites.title: kestrel journal
sites.description: Jo Halloran's journal, written mostly after shifts at the Blue Kestrel diner in Gridfall.

sites.title: Verity Mail
sites.description: Your inbox. Eleven things want money, four want your attention, two are from people. The junk folder is where the machines are having the most fun.

sites.title: Marchfield Farmers Cooperative Association
sites.description: The website of a member-owned grain elevator on County Road 9 east of Marchfield, last changed in October 2014.

sites.title: Marchfield Public Library - Notes from the Reference Desk
sites.description: The Marchfield Public Library's blog: hours, closures, the Friends' book sale, and Karen Fennimore's notes from the microfilm reader.

sites.title: marla's page !!!
sites.description: Personal page belonging to Marla Kesswick of Marchfield, updated whenever she feels like it.

sites.title: The Milbrook Gazette
sites.description: The weekly paper for Milbrook and the north end of Verity County, published Thursdays since 1908. The last edition is 27 October 2016 and says the pause is temporary.

sites.title: VFW Post 6791 - Milbrook
sites.description: The Veterans of Foreign Wars post in Milbrook: hall rental rates in detail because the hall pays for the building, a Friday fish fry, the Memorial Day parade route, the members who have died since last May, the Auxiliary, and the village notices this page carries because Milbrook has had no newspaper since 2016.

sites.title: New Carrow Today
sites.description: A local news site for a village of 3,140, published off the same template as four hundred others, with no staff page, no phone number and no address.

sites.title: New Carrow Fire District
sites.description: Station 3 in New Carrow: a levy explainer written for the 3 November ballot, five years of monthly call counts that go up while the fires do not, a burn notice form, a roster of twenty-nine, a pork dinner, and a comment box that cannot be switched off.

sites.title: ClipVault Now
sites.description: ClipVault in 2026. Nine channels serving Verity County, seven of which are not operated by anyone in Verity County.

sites.title: The Verity Ledger
sites.description: Verity County's newspaper since 1901, now a content pipeline operated by Pinelock Media Group. No reporter has worked here since 2019.

sites.title: Gridfall Swap Shop (archived)
sites.description: ARCHIVED AND READ ONLY -- registration and posting closed on 30 September 2016, everything posted here since 2009 is still where it was, and the board people use now is gridfallswap.net.

sites.title: Pinelock Media Group
sites.description: The corporate site of the holding company that owns the Verity Ledger and thirty other local news properties, with an investor page, a careers page and no reporters.

sites.title: Gridfall Pulse
sites.description: A small microblog for Gridfall and the rest of Verity County. Mostly road closures.

sites.title: The Quarry Cut on Route 62
sites.description: Ray Sabo's page about the road cut and abandoned quarry on County Route 62 east of Ashkettle: a measured section, the quarry's dates, access rules, and six years of shortwave reception logs. Last updated October 2009.

sites.title: Verity County Scanner Log
sites.description: A retired county dispatcher's scanner log: fire, EMS and police traffic written down as it goes out, nightly since April 2009.

sites.title: SDR Listeners
sites.description: A national shortwave and software-defined-radio listening board, running since 2004, where Verity County is one thread among antennas, noise floors and receivers nobody makes any more.

sites.title: ShopWell — Everything, Somehow, By Tomorrow
sites.description: A marketplace with eleven million listings and about four hundred actual products. Prices move while you look at them. Every review is five stars and none of them are about the thing you are buying.

sites.title: Shoutbox
sites.description: Where Verity County is discussed in 2026, by accounts that are mostly not in Verity County and mostly not people.

sites.title: Verity County Amateur Astronomers
sites.description: Home page of the Verity County Amateur Astronomers, meeting monthly since 1978 and observing from Perrin Hill.

sites.title: St Mark's Lutheran Church - Marchfield
sites.description: A Marchfield congregation's website, kept up by the church secretary: service times, a food pantry page with real hours and a real shortage list, a bulletin archive whose files are no longer linked, the parish hall roof fund, and the memorial list.

sites.title: Account Suspended
sites.description: The page Gridfall Host serves in place of any site whose account is past due, over quota or unrenewed: one paragraph, a phone number and a footer.

sites.title: The Quarry
sites.description: A one-person county newsletter out of Gridfall, written monthly by Ruth Cannady, the other reporter Pinelock cut from the Ledger in 2019, who kept going to the meetings.

sites.title: Thomas Norris
sites.description: The page of Thomas Norris, retired Verity County surveyor, including a detailed account of the flood of June 1994.

sites.title: Verity Branch Trail Users
sites.description: The users' board for the Verity Branch Trail, nominally run by the county parks department, which last posted a mowing notice in November 2023.

sites.title: Boy Scout Troop 62 - Gridfall
sites.description: Scout Troop 62 of Gridfall, on a template a parent bought in 2007: a calendar that stops in June 2012, a merit badge counsellor list with phone numbers, the pancake breakfast accounts back to 2007, an Eagle Scout list, and a photo album in which not one picture comes up.

sites.title: Verity County Regional Careers Portal
sites.description: A hiring page that is not one: work-from-home offers under the names of Verity Valley Power & Light and County General, an offer letter with the applicant's name still in the merge field, and a refundable verification deposit that has to be paid in gift cards.

sites.title: Verity County Transit Division
sites.description: Two bus routes, a dial-a-ride line that answers three and a half hours a day, and a detour around the Quarry Road culvert that has been posted since July.

sites.title: Verity County Services Portal
sites.description: The official services portal for Verity County. Fourteen services, four working phone numbers, and one form that requires software discontinued in 2011.

sites.title: Verity Wiki
sites.description: A county wiki for Verity County, still edited by hand by about six people and by a great many things that are not people.

sites.title: VerityAnswers
sites.description: A local questions-and-answers site where the accepted answer is whichever one arrived first, and the correct one is underneath it at two votes.

sites.title: Verity County Bird Club
sites.description: The message board of the Verity County Bird Club, founded 1961: dated sightings with counts, a Christmas count archive back to 2004, a swap board for optics, and a falcon at the quarry cut the records committee would not accept.

sites.title: Verity County Clerk
sites.description: The County Clerk's office in Gridfall: records requests on Form VC-114, marriage licenses, the fee schedule, certified election results back to 1994, and one microfilm reader in the basement that you have to book.

sites.title: Verity County Today
sites.description: A locally named news site with no staff page, no phone number and no address, published by Meridian Local Network, which runs four hundred of them.

sites.title: Verity County Cooperative Extension
sites.description: The county extension office on Herron Road: soil test bags, the applicator recertification date, the 4-H premium book, two tree disease alerts, and which beetle it actually is.

sites.title: verityfeed.social
sites.description: A 180-account fediverse instance for Verity County, run by one woman in Halsey on a $14 VPS, half full of people who joined because the name was available.

sites.title: Verity County Health Department
sites.description: Food inspection reports with the scores and the violation text as written, septic permits, autumn immunization clinics and free well water testing. One sanitarian, one vacancy, and a health officer who is here eight hours a week.

sites.title: The Verity Ledger
sites.description: The Verity County paper of record, published in Gridfall since 1901.

sites.title: Verity Monument Company - Gridfall, since 1949
sites.description: Granite, lettering, foundations and the cemetery rules for seven townships, from a Gridfall shop the Almquists have run since 1949, on a platform that gives a grave marker four and a half stars.

sites.title: The Verity Piecers
sites.description: A quilt guild in Marchfield: meeting minutes, the block of the month with the cutting written out, the comfort quilt count, the raffle quilt, and one obituary.

sites.title: Verity Rail Preservation Society
sites.description: The society that keeps the paper, the caboose and the freight house fund for the Marchfield and Coyne Flats branch line, last updated September 2009.

sites.title: Verity Rail Company
sites.description: The corporate web site of Verity Rail Company, a regional freight railroad, unchanged since June 2011 when it conveyed the last of its Verity County branch corridors to the county.

sites.title: Verity Real Estate Now
sites.description: A real estate content site covering Verity County, twelve articles deep, every one of them built from the same seven headings and a different population figure.

sites.title: Verity County Sheriff's Office
sites.description: Road patrol, civil process and the county jail for Verity County, plus the daily blotter, which is the most-read page in the county and the one nothing links to.

sites.title: The Verity Signal
sites.description: Curtis Flenn has been logging the Signal on County Route 62 since March 2004 and has not got any closer, which has not stopped him writing it down.

sites.title: Verity Valley Water Board
sites.description: Agendas, minutes, the rate schedule, the annual water quality report, the hydrant flushing zones and every boil water notice since 2018, for the two wells and 31.4 miles of main that serve Gridfall, Coyne Flats and Tessler.

sites.title: Verity News Service
sites.description: A small regional wire filing county copy to the outlets that are left, which is why the same paragraph turns up on three of them.

sites.title: VerityNet Dial-Up
sites.description: The county dial-up provider as it stood in September 2004: access numbers by town, modem settings, the personal pages policy, webmail, and the outage log.

sites.title: Verity Valley Power & Light - News & Announcements
sites.description: Corporate announcements from Verity Valley Power & Light. Posted when there is an announcement, which is not often. Comments are not enabled.

sites.title: The Gridfall Webring
sites.description: Hub of the Gridfall Webring, linking personal and community sites in and about Verity County.

sites.title: The Verity County Wiki
sites.description: A community-maintained wiki covering Verity County, its towns, institutions and arguments.
